articles.summary: A transparent GitHub proxy, leveraging Tailscale Services and Squid, was built to overcome ISP degradation that was causing GitHub Actions jobs to fail. This internal solution reroutes GitHub traffic through a stable, alternate network path, providing defense-in-depth for runners with zero changes required from customers.
articles.title: How Blacksmith survives ISP degradation with Tailscale Services

articles.summary: GitHub is adding a $0.002-per-minute fee on all GitHub Actions usage, so the control plane is no longer free.
articles.title: The GitHub Actions control plane is no longer free
